entry.title: The Horn of Plenty (Wikipedia — did you know?)

entry.content: ... that Fen Juhua became the "first of the lady knights in the Chinese cinema" after fighting for love in a 1925 film?

entry.title: the offices (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that the offices of Hamm's Brewery in Saint Paul, Minnesota, were built on the site of the city's third cathedral?

entry.title: Miles Rock (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Miles Rock served as chief of the commission that determined the disputed Guatemala–Mexico border?

entry.title: the 2025 season (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that the 2025 season of Inter Miami CF includes matches in the 2025 FIFA Club World Cup?

entry.title: Anthony F. Ciampi (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Anthony F. Ciampi fought his superiors to rebuild the College of the Holy Cross after it was destroyed by fire in 1852?

entry.title: a documentary film (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that a documentary film built around the final interview of K-pop star Sulli employs elements of The Wonderful Wizard of Oz as a framing device?

entry.title: Diane Leather (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Diane Leather was the first woman to run a mile in under five minutes?

entry.title: HMS Unruffled (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that a cat, Timoshenko, joined the British submarine HMS Unruffled on twenty patrols during the Second World War?
